How to install JamoMovieE

01

⇩
02

▣
03

Review the Android prompt

Android may ask you to allow installation from the app you used to download the file. Review the prompt and allow it only if you trust this source.

⚙

⬇

About Android security warnings
Android and Google Play Protect may show a warning when an app is installed from outside Google Play. This warning does not by itself prove that an app contains a virus, but it also does not prove the file is safe. Only install APKs from a source you trust. Do not turn off device protection just to install an app; stop and contact the publisher if you are uncertain.
